name: Firmus

source.quote: The transaction brings the company’s total new equity raised over the past year to more than $3bn, and it said its post-money valuation is now above $10.5bn.

description: Australian developer of liquid-cooled AI data centers ('AI factories') running Nvidia GPUs, starting in Tasmania.
explain: Firmus is building Nvidia-based AI data centers across Australia, backed by repeated Nvidia investments and a $10 billion debt facility from Blackstone and Coatue.
